text: 朵朵跟着光线往里走。光线穿过角膜和晶状体，进入眼睛。
Duoduo follows the light. It passes through the cornea and lens, into the eye.
“它们在那里会合啦！”朵朵说。眼睛清楚聚焦时，光线会在眼睛后面的视网膜上会合。
“There they meet!” says Duoduo. When the eye focuses clearly, light comes together on the retina at the back of the eye.
“让我试试！”朵朵拖动滑块，看看光线在哪里会合。你能帮她戴上眼镜，让焦点回到视网膜上吗？
“Let me try!” Duoduo moves the slider to see where the light meets. Can you help her bring the focus back to the retina with glasses?
牙齿城里亮起了橙色灯光。“午夜酸雨警报！”泡泡赶紧凑过去，想弄清楚发生了什么。
An orange light glows inside Tooth City. “The midnight acid alarm!” Paopao hurries over to find out what is happening.
泡泡发现了一个热闹的微生物社区。这里的居民各不相同！有些细菌会参与蛀牙的过程，还有许多微生物安静地生活在嘴巴里。
Paopao discovers a busy community of tiny microbes. They are all different! Some bacteria take part in tooth decay, while others live peacefully in the mouth.
“我的零食还留在这里呀！”含糖和淀粉的食物碎屑留在牙面黏黏的牙菌斑附近，有些细菌正利用这些食物残渣。
“Some of my snack is still here!” Bits of food with sugar and starch linger near sticky plaque on the teeth. Some bacteria use these leftovers.
泡泡沿着橙色小滴寻找线索。原来，部分细菌利用糖和淀粉时会产生酸。“这就是警报响起的原因呀！”
Paopao follows the trail of orange drops. Some bacteria make acid as they use sugars and starches. “So that is what set off the alarm!”
泡泡仔细观察牙齿坚硬的外层——牙釉质。酸反复起作用，会让这里的矿物质慢慢流失。蛀洞是逐渐形成的，并不是吃一次零食就会出现。
Paopao looks closely at the tooth’s hard outer layer, the enamel. Repeated acid attacks can slowly take away its minerals. A cavity takes time to form—it does not appear after just one snack.
